extraction.Name: Maggie Williams
extraction.Refused/Protested: she took it but did not want it. She thought that she had to take the patent in fee as it was sent to her but she had never made any application for the patent in fee.
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: sold the land for $5000.00 to some one through Chas. Bates
extraction.Buyer: some one through Chas. Bates for $5000.00
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: it was a great hard-ship to her as her husband was sick and children were small and had to take care of her aged mother. Her husband died and the expense was great and she lost some money that was in the Bank and had to borrow money to pay taxes.
extraction.Occupation/Income: keeping house for an old Indian lady; tries to raise chickens and a garden
extraction.NOTES: Mentally competent and in fair health; has aged mother who is 82 years old to care for; has not received any help from the Government, State or County since she received a patent in fee; husband died; document received at Pine Ridge Agency Dec. 29, 1928; subscribed and sworn before notary public Dec. 4, 1928; County of Washabaugh, State of South Dakota. | ORIGINAL_TRIBE_VALUE: "Pine Ridge Agency" (normalized 2026-04-28 to canonical 'Pine Ridge')

recovery_notes.rationale: Pine Ridge tribe field had 40+ string variants across the corpus. Consolidating to canonical 'Pine Ridge' for clean tabulation while preserving original variant in NOTES for audit.
